headline: Review the fixed Sepolia proposal.
intro: This separate workspace prepares five unsigned transaction envelopes for the recorded test USDC proposal. It does not read current chain state, use an API key, open a wallet, sign or broadcast.
provenanceHelp: The source is integration/demo-proposal.json. The fixture is local and records no current API or chain observation.
reviewHelp: Approval is bound to the exact preview hash below. It creates the five local unsigned envelopes. It does not authorize signing or a chain write.
approvalCurrent: Owner approval is current for this workspace revision.
approvalExpired: Owner approval expired. Prepare and approve a fresh review.
approvalStale: Owner approval is stale because the workspace revision changed. Prepare a fresh review.
approvalMissing: Owner approval has not been recorded.
actionsHelp: The owner actions are setAction, token approve, grant and revoke. The agent action is execute. Every envelope keeps signingReady and chainWriteAuthorized false.
agentHelp: Preflight revalidates the approval, workspace revision and all five received artifacts against expectations rebuilt from the fixed reviewed fixture and preview inputs. This local check does not authenticate external evidence. Execute then stops because no authorized signing adapter exists.
noReceipt: No execution attempt has been recorded.
empty: Prepare the fixed proposal to begin.
saved: The local Sepolia workspace was updated.
networkError: The local app connection was lost. Refresh the workspace before continuing.
footer: Separate from the synthetic MDT simulation. No blockchain transaction is made here.
